items.item_text: High School Graduate General Studies, or
Experience in surgery in a parallelposition
Prior experience with Lift or Transport Team

Identifies patient with unit nurse prior to transportation to the Operating Room. Uses AIDET in communications with patients, families and visitors. Reports observed behaviors to the Lead RN in SPU, OR or circulating RN. Provides for patient comfort and modesty during transportation to the Operating Room. Complies with Child Security Policies and Procedures. Prepares and maintains equipment and supplies for the transportation of patients to the operating room. Prepares and maintains supplies needed for rapid turnover of ORs between cases.

Informs director or designee when supplies or materials are needed. Removes broken or malfunctioning instruments or equipment from use notifying the director or designee. Tags malfunctioning equipment per policy.

Assists with the cleaning of the operating rooms as indicated by need and consistent with departmental guidelines. Removes all exposed equipment and supplies used and unused. Disposes of soiled linens, sharps and biohazard waste in accordance with safety standards. Stores new supplies in proper location, retrieves sterile supplies, linens, dressing, instruments, basins, solutions and special equipment as directed. Keeps supplies in proper allocated space and off floors. Consistently keeps the linen stocked in the linen cabinets. Maintains adequate supply of surgical prep sink and PPE equipment.

Follows basic principles of aseptic technique and operating room traffic control. Wears appropriate PPE and ortho garb as required. Understands and complies with Universal Blood and Body Fluid Precautions while fulfilling responsibilities in the department.

Communicates effectively with staff, patients and the public using AIDET principles. May participate in the orientation of new employees. Participates in unit staff meetings, hospital wide mandatory education programs and special assignments. Supports all hospital and departmental Quality initiatives.
Transports contaminated and sterile instruments to and from patient care areas safely. Performs other room duties as assigned.
